summary: PM collect_work expands what_next ready_issue / issue_number into concrete issue-# rows with Closes prompts so approve&run can open feature/bug loops (#660/#654).
migration_impact: PM cycles that previously queued a single process what_next blob now propose issue-N assignments when what_next returns ready candidates. Agents should Approve & run those rows (status=run) instead of inventing process-only packets.
migration_guidance: 2. plate_pm_run_cycle dry_run → expect issue-<n> work_ids when ready Features/Bugs exist.
3. plate_pm_complete status=run on those rows to dispatch loops linked to the GitHub issue.
agent_notes: When ready_issues present, process what_next blob is omitted to avoid duplicate non-actionable queue noise. classify_work_type uses Bug/Feature labels for bugfix vs implement.
